source.content: trigger AccountEnterpriseTrigger on Account (before insert, before update, after update) { if (Trigger.isBefore && Trigger.isInsert) { for (Account row : Trigger.new) { row.Rating = 'Warm'; } } if (Trigger.isBefore && Trigger.isUpdate) { Account oldRow = Trigger.old.get(0); for (Account row : Trigger.new) { if (oldRow.Name == 'Acme') { row.Name = 'Changed'; } } } if (Trigger.isAfter && Trigger.isUpdate) { System.assertEquals(Trigger.size, Trigger.new.size()); } }

@isTest private class EnterpriseTriggerFixtureTest { @isTest static void exercisesTriggerContexts() { Account account = new Account(Name = 'Acme'); insert account; Id accountId = account.Id; Account inserted = [SELECT Id, Name, Rating FROM Account WHERE Id = :accountId]; String insertedRating = inserted.Rating; System.assertEquals('Warm', insertedRating); inserted.Name = 'Next'; update inserted; Account updated = [SELECT Id, Name, Rating FROM Account WHERE Id = :accountId]; String updatedName = updated.Name; String updatedRating = updated.Rating; System.assertEquals('Changed', updatedName); System.assertEquals('Warm', updatedRating); } }
